name: realloc-failure
title: Preserve the original pointer when realloc fails
lesson: Assigning realloc directly back to the only pointer can lose the original allocation on failure.
fix_goal: Store realloc's result in a temporary pointer before replacing the original.
fix_steps: Call realloc into a temporary pointer.
Only replace the original pointer after the temporary result is non-NULL.
On failure, keep and clean up the original allocation.
